alternatives.name: EXPLICIT_FINALITY_WITH_HISTORY
tradeoffs: Reorgs and state changes require history preservation rather than silent rewrite.

decision.summary: Blockchain events use explicit finality states (SEEN, PENDING, CONFIRMED, FINALIZED, REORGED, FAILED) with chain-specific parameters. State transitions preserve history.
decision.title: Blockchain time, finality, and reorg semantics

effectivity.non_authorization_statement: Proposed status does not authorize on-chain ingestion, node connections, or wallet labeling.
